hypotheses.justification: It follows from the remaining [AddCommGroup M], [TopologicalSpace M], and [DiscreteTopology M]. Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Group/ContinuousInv.lean provides this instance via the additive version of isTopologicalGroup_of_discreteTopology. Using `omit [IsTopologicalAddGroup M] in`, the statement still elaborates and the proof remains `by rfl`. The instance also applies to the trivial group; no additional nontriviality assumption is needed.
